summary_1line: Arjuna defeats the Gandharvas but halts when their king Chitrasena reveals himself, and Yudhishthira later frees the captured Duryodhana despite his malicious intent.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna fires a vast net of arrows into the sky, trapping airborne Gandharvas like birds in a cage.
Severed limbs and weapons rain from the sky as Arjuna’s crescent-shaped arrows cut down the Gandharvas above him.
Arjuna’s arrow shatters Chitrasena’s iron mace into seven pieces midair as the Gandharva king charges from the sky.
